dave_acme: Hey team — onboarding Acme's BYOK for Azure Key Vault. We have key URI: https://acme-kv.vault.azure.net/keys/ri-rootkey. Need to confirm required RBAC/policies, audit logging requirements, and how Redwood handles key rotation. Any quick checklist?

ben_support: Thanks, @dave_acme. Quick checklist off the top of my head: 1) key URI (you provided) 2) grant wrapKey/unwrapKey/get to Redwood principal 3) decide MI vs SPN and share principal id 4) enable diagnostic logs (EventHub/Storage/Log Analytics) for 90d retention 5) enable soft-delete + purge-protection on vault.

carla_sec: Security note — for envelope encryption we only need crypto ops, do NOT grant Key Vault Administrator unless you must. Recommended Azure RBAC role: `Key Vault Crypto User` or an access policy with `Key permissions: wrapKey, unwrapKey, get`. Also enable `soft-delete` and `purge-protection` so keys can't be removed during onboarding.

alice_ops: To validate from your side run: `az keyvault key show --vault-name acme-kv --name ri-rootkey` and `az keyvault set-policy --name acme-kv --spn <SPN> --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get`. Example: 
```
az keyvault set-policy --name acme-kv --spn 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get
```
Then run our validation endpoint (one-time): 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_uri":"https://acme-kv.vault.azure.net/keys/ri-rootkey"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/validate-key
```
This returns a small nonce we ask you to sign/unwrap to confirm access.

kms-bot: Integration-checker: validation job queued for `https://acme-kv.vault.azure.net/keys/ri-rootkey`. I will post results here when ready.

ben_support: Also need to know whether you want cross-subscription diagnostics (Event Hub) or same-subscription (Storage). If cross-subscription, enable a SAS or EventHub connection string for us to validate logs — we only read diagnostics metadata for audit verification.

dave_acme: We're using a system-assigned managed identity on our infra and prefer Event Hub in a central sec subscription. For rotation: we want monthly key rotation. Will Redwood automatically rewrap existing envelope keys when key version rotates?

carla_sec: Short answer: no automatic bulk rewrap. Redwood will use the latest active key version for new envelopes. Existing stored customer data keys (encrypted envelopes) are not re-encrypted automatically to avoid mass IO and potential regressions. If you require all envelopes rewrapped we can run a controlled rewrap job (requires downtime window or snapshot and both old+new key versions available). That job includes audit events for every rewrap and a pre-check.

alice_ops: Filed docs gap — docs currently don't show how to configure cross-subscription Diagnostic Settings to Event Hub for Key Vault. I'll open a docs ticket to add step-by-step and a sample ARM template. For now, manual steps: in portal -> Key Vault -> Diagnostic settings -> Add diagnostic setting -> send to Event Hub -> select namespace -> enable `AuditEvent` and `AllMetrics`. Set retention 90 days.

ben_support: Raised onboarding ticket #ONB-3821 and assigned to eng-ops. Please paste your subscription id and the MI principal id here and I'll attach them to the ticket. Also include a sample telemetry blob or the Event Hub namespace so we can test log ingestion. :thumbsup: 

dave_acme: Subscription ID `11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888`, MI principal id `f1e2d3c4-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-1234567890ab`. Event Hub namespace `sec-telemetry-eu`. Posting the Event Hub SAS key via secure support upload now.

kms-bot: Integration-checker: preliminary validation succeeded (wrap/unwrap permissions OK). Next step: Redwood will attempt a test wrap/unwrap using latest key version within 1 hour and post results.

ben_support: Great — once kms-bot posts final success we'll move to production enablement. If you want a monthly rotation policy we recommend `rotation + new envelope usage` pattern and a scheduled rewrap cadence only if necessary. If you want a quote for bulk rewrap, we'll handle via eng professional services.

dave_acme: Thanks all, that helps. I'll wait for the kms-bot confirmation and follow up if we want the rewrap quote.

carla_sec: One last security pointer: enable alerts on unusual number of unwrap operations (could indicate exfil attempts). Recommend adding an Azure Monitor alert for KeyVault `UnwrapKey` metric > baseline.

alice_ops: noted — adding alert runbook to onboarding ticket. Will update docs + ticket ONB-3821 with next steps and timeline.
